hero.title: The digital revolution in sports equipment
hero.subtitle: We're transforming a traditional industry with modern technology and user-friendly solutions

mission.title: Our mission
mission.content: We're on a mission to revolutionize how sports clubs order and manage their equipment. Through our IT-driven approach, we eliminate wasted time, reduce errors, and give clubs full control over their equipment needs.

story.title: From frustration to innovation
story.intro: It all started with a simple observation: Why should clubs in 2025 still send Excel sheets back and forth via email to order sports equipment?
story.problem: We saw coaches spending hours on administration instead of coaching. We saw club managers struggling with unmanageable budgets. We saw suppliers drowning in emails and manual processes.
story.solution: So we built the solution: Denmark's first fully digital platform for ordering sports equipment. A platform that makes it easy to be a club, coach, and supplier.
